snippets.content: on: schedule cron "0 23 * * *" + workflow_dispatch; permissions: contents: write; concurrency: group narrative-snapshot, cancel-in-progress false

snippets.description: Run step: pytrends added per-run, exit 1 fails, exit 2 warns
snippets.content: uv run --project api --with pytrends python -m api.scripts.snapshot_narrative

snippets.description: Commit/push: stages only api/data/cache/narrative/, commit-if-diff, pull --rebase + push with 3 retries
snippets.content: git add api/data/cache/narrative/ ... git pull --rebase origin "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" && git push

snippets.description: Read-before-write first-observation-wins; the only writes are write_narrative_point (pytrends, coingecko-narrative), reddit_adapter.fetch_mentions (creds set only) and exchange_attention.run_daily (append-only)
